e.title: InsureRisk：非寿险 GLM 定价库，含监管费率申报导出与「用户须自行验证」的责任清单
e.title_en: InsureRisk: a non-life GLM pricing library with regulatory rate-filing export and an explicit list of what the user must validate themselves
e.title_hk: InsureRisk：非壽險 GLM 定價庫，含監管費率申報導出與「用戶須自行驗證」的責任清單
e.summary: 一个面向非寿险的频率-严重度 GLM 定价库：含泊松到 Tweedie 的分布族、R 式公式语法、GAM 与单调约束 GLM 等变体、费率表与评分引擎、经验修正与可信度加权、价格弹性与受限费率优化，并能导出 SERFF 合规的申报 XML／CSV 并对受保护类别属性做反歧视检查；其许可说明单列一节写明「这是计算工具而非财务或精算意见」，并把输出验证、监管合规与专业复核的责任明确交给使用者
e.summary_hk: 一個面向非壽險的頻率-嚴重度 GLM 定價庫：含泊松到 Tweedie 的分布族、R 式公式語法、GAM 與單調約束 GLM 等變體、費率表與評分引擎、經驗修正與可信度加權、價格彈性與受限費率優化，並能導出 SERFF 合規的申報 XML／CSV 並對受保護類別屬性做反歧視檢查；其許可說明單列一節寫明「這是計算工具而非財務或精算意見」，並把輸出驗證、監管合規與專業複核的責任明確交給使用者
e.summary_en: A frequency-severity GLM pricing library for non-life insurance: distribution families from Poisson to Tweedie, R-style formula syntax, GAM and monotonicity-constrained GLM variants, tariff tables with a rating engine, experience modification and credibility weighting, price elasticity and constrained rate optimisation, plus export of SERFF-compliant filing XML/CSV and anti-discrimination checks on protected-class attributes; its licensing document has a section stating it is a computational tool rather than financial or actuarial advice, and places responsibility for validating outputs, regulatory compliance and professional review squarely on the user
e.body:
**InsureRisk** 是一个**面向非寿险的频率-严重度 GLM 定价库**（仓库 `23BCE0066/InsureRisk-Insurance-Pricing-Risk-Analytics`），**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 Python、仓库体量 259 KB、创建与最后推送均为 2026-09-07**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，在解冻窗口内**）；**⚠️ 许可情形特殊——GitHub API 报 `NONE` 且根目录**没有 `LICENSE` 文件（实测 404）**，**但仓库内另有一份 **`LICENSING.md`（6,176 字节）**逐字声明为 **Mozilla Public License v2.0（MPL-2.0）**并详列权利与义务**（**详见下方标注 ①**）；**无 topics**；**README 实测 20,121 字节**。本条目属于本轮主题**「说清楚什么算它是对的」**中的**第一种：它把「谁该为输出负责」写得极为明确**。

可核实信息（**均 README、`LICENSING.md` 与仓库根目录实测**）：**README 标题逐字为「InsureRisk」，副标题逐字为「Modern Actuarial Pricing Library for Non-Life Insurance」**，**定位句逐字为「InsureRisk is a Python library for building **GLM-based frequency-severity pricing models** with a focus on **actuarial best practices**.」**。**根目录实测**：**`.github`、`.gitignore`、`.pre-commit-config.yaml`、`.readthedocs.yaml`、`.tmp_changelog.txt`、`INSTALLATION.md`（6,228 字节）、**`LICENSING.md`（6,176 字节）**、`README.md`（20,121 字节）、`docs/`、`examples/`、`fix_docstrings.py`、`insurerisk/`、`package-lock.json`、`package.json`、`pyproject.toml`、`tests/`**；**安装方式逐字为 `pip install insurerisk`**，**当前版本实测为 **0.3.1****。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「Not Investment Advice」一节把**用户责任**逐条写出来，是本条目最值得引用的一处**——**`LICENSING.md` 逐字为**：**「InsureRisk is a **computational tool**, not financial or actuarial advice. **Users are responsible for:** Validation of outputs in their specific context; Compliance with applicable insurance regulations; **Professional review of any models built with InsureRisk**; Appropriateness of assumptions and data.」**——**即「这是一个**计算工具**，不是财务或精算意见。使用者须自行负责：在自身情境下**验证输出**、**遵守适用的保险监管规定**、**对用本库建立的任何模型进行专业复核**、以及**假设与数据的适当性**」**。⭐⭐ **对准备把这类库用进作业或实习的学生，这四条恰好是一条**从代码到可辩护结论**的检查清单**（**可与 [[verified-reserving]]、[[reproducible-actuarial-work]]、[[fair-pricing-playbook]]、[[insurance-governance]] 并读**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **监管申报能力是本条目在功能上最值得注意的地方**——**README 单设「Regulatory Compliance」一节，逐字含三项**：**① `insurerisk.compliance.RateIndicationSummary`——报告实际赔付率、指示费率、可信度权重与**复核用选择标记**；② `insurerisk.compliance.RateFilingPackage`——打包费率指示与错位分析，**并对受保护类别属性运行反歧视检查**；③ `insurerisk.compliance.SERFFExporter`——把费率相对数导出为 **SERFF 合规的 XML 或扁平 CSV 供监管提交（例如 AR、CA、GR 申报）**」**。⭐⭐⭐ **在美国，费率申报是**受监管的正式动作**，而 SERFF 是各州使用的申报系统——**一个开源库做到导出 SERFF 格式并内置反歧视检查，说明其目标用户是**真的要做申报的定价人员****（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其导出格式确实符合 SERFF 的技术规范或任何州的要求**——**本次未运行、未查看任何导出文件**；**⚠️ 「反歧视检查」的具体判定规则本次亦未读**，**且**费率公平性在监管上有多套并存的检验方法**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **七种 GLM 变体把「同一个频率-严重度框架」扩到不同统计需求上，是本条目在方法上最有用的一组**——**`GAM`**（平滑非线性效应）；**`MonotoneGLM`**（**对有序类别预测变量施加拟合后单调性约束**）；**`QuantileGLM`**（条件分位数回归，含严重度扇形图）；**`BayesianGLM`**（基于 PyMC 的贝叶斯泊松／伽马 GLM，输出可信区间，需可选依赖 `pymc`）；**`HierarchicalGLM`**（混合效应／分层 GLM，基于 statsmodels 的 `MixedLM`，非高斯族可选用 pymer4／rpy2）**。⭐ **其中 `MonotoneGLM` 值得单独记**：**在费率表中，**某个因子应当单调**（例如年龄越大风险越高）常是业务或监管上的要求**，**而普通 GLM 拟合出的系数未必单调**；**拟合后施加单调约束，是把**统计拟合**与**业务可解释性**接起来的做法**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其实现方法或效果**——**本次未读源码**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **一处**命名冲突的自我披露**在本会话很少见**——**README 逐字为**：**「Note: `insurerisk.glm.qpp.FrequencyModel` is a **lightweight QPP-specific wrapper** and is **distinct from** the top-level `insurerisk.FrequencyModel` frequency-severity workflow class.」**——**即同一个包里**两个不同类共用 `FrequencyModel` 这一名字**，**作者在发行说明里主动指出这一点**。⭐⭐ **对要维护较长生命周期的库，这类**明知有坑而先说明**的做法，比事后在 issue 里解释有用得多**（**可与第 330 轮 [[actuary-os]] 的「已锁定的决定」、第 328 轮 [[creance]] 的「调度器只打印计划」并读**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **「Quantile Premium Principle（QPP）」是本条目在定价思想上最特殊的一项**——**逐字说明其做法为「prices policies from the **policy-specific severity quantile implied by the frequency model’s zero-claim probability**, **rather than the expected loss**」**——**即不用期望损失，而用**由零索赔概率所隐含的保单特有严重度分位数**来定价**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该定价原则在理论上恰当或已被采用**——**本次未读其推导**；**⚠️ 另注：README 自己提醒该模块的 `FrequencyModel` 与顶层同名类不同，见上**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ **其余功能覆盖面很宽且都属定价实务的真实环节**——**分布族含泊松、负二项、伽马、逆高斯、对数正态与 **Tweedie****；**联结函数含 log、identity、inverse、inverse squared**；**⭐ **「针对基于暴露度的频率模型做正确的 offset 处理」被单独列出**；**诊断含 AIC／BIC／偏差／离散度／**过度离散检验****；**模型验证含 **VIF（方差膨胀因子）**与相关性分析**；**预测表现含提升曲线、**Gini 指数**与残差图**；**暴露度计算支持天／月／年三种方法与自定义日期列**；**费率工具含基准费率与因子相对数、因子套用、**趋势调整**、**on-leveling（期中费率变更调整）**、**经验修正（EMR／XMod）**、**可信度加权****；**组合与影响分析含保费影响、**结构漂移分解（mix-shift）**、赢家／输家分段、费率充足性、**价格弹性与需求曲线**、留存建模，以及**受限费率优化**（`ConstrainedRateOptimizer`，结合可信度约束与线性规划，并含错位分析）**；**数据工具含 `DataQualityChecker`（缺失／离群报告、缩尾、因子合并、自动分箱、**泄漏检查**与校准曲线）与 `AutoImputer`**。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **工程质量有可核实的交代**——**逐字为「Testing: **68%+ test coverage with pytest**」**；**根目录实测含 `.pre-commit-config.yaml` 与 **`.readthedocs.yaml`**（**即配置了 pre-commit 钩子与 Read the Docs 文档构建**）；**README 另有「Behavior note」逐字说明**：**「`SeverityGLM.fit` performs **zero filtering automatically** and lognormal family is **internally handled with transformation**.」**——**即把两处**不显眼但会改变结果的内部行为**写在了发行说明里**。**⑧ ⭐ **与本站定价与 GLM 条目并读**：[[insurance-pricing-tweedie]]、[[tweedie-python]]、[[easy-glm]]、[[insurance-glm-tools]]、[[insurance-distributional-glm]]、[[shap-relativities]]、[[ratemaking]]、[[openrater]]、[[ratecraft]]、[[fair-pricing-playbook]]、[[glm]]、[[insurance-credibility]]、[[mg-credibility]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️ 许可情形须分三点说清**：**GitHub API 实测许可字段为 `NONE`**；**根目录**没有 `LICENSE` 文件**（`raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测 **404**，且根目录清单中确无之）；**而 `LICENSING.md`（6,176 字节）逐字声明为「**Mozilla Public License v2.0 (MPL-2.0)**」，并逐条列出 MPL-2.0 的权利（可用于商业项目、可修改、可以 MPL-2.0 分发修改版、**可与专有代码链接**、可纳入 SaaS）与义务（分发时须**附上许可副本**、须有显著声明、修改版须提供源码、须保留版权与作者归属），另含「**内部使用例外**：仅在内部使用而不分发则不产生义务」。⭐⭐ **值得注意的是：该文件自己要求「Include License: Provide a copy of the MPL-2.0 license」，而它所指的 `LICENSE` 文件并不存在**。**本词条据此记录：**许可意图明确且写得详尽，但**标准许可文件缺失**，**故 GitHub 无法识别、使用者也无从取得该许可正文****；**使用、修改或分发前应自行确认**（**⚠️ 可与第 330 轮 [[geo-catastrophe-pricing]]、[[west-bengal-flood-cat-model]] 与本轮 [[aida-tix-anomaly-detection]]、[[insurers-101]] 的许可情形对照——**本轮四条中有三条**声称许可而无许可文件****，**详见本轮日志**）；**②** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、根目录清单、README（20,121 字节）全文与 `LICENSING.md`（6,176 字节）全文**，⭐⭐ **但**未安装 `pip install insurerisk`、未运行任何模型、未执行其测试、未读 `insurerisk/` 下任何源码、未读 `docs/` 与 `examples/`、未读 `INSTALLATION.md`、未查看任何导出文件****，因此**不能转述其 GLM 实现细节、七种变体的算法、费率表结构、SERFF 导出的实际格式、约束优化的目标函数或任何数值**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实** `SERFFExporter` 的导出确实符合 SERFF 的技术规范或任何州的申报要求**——**本词条只核实在 README 中被如此描述**；**这是本条目最需要后续核实的一处**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实** `RateFilingPackage` 的「反歧视检查」具体检查什么、依据何种准则**——**费率公平性存在多套并存且互相不完全一致的检验方法**；**本词条**不主张**该检查足以满足任何监管要求**；**⑤ ⭐⭐ **未核实** `MonotoneGLM` 施加单调约束的具体算法与其对拟合优度的影响**；**⑥ ⭐⭐ **未核实** QPP（分位数保费原则）的理论依据与适用条件**；**⑦ ⭐⭐ **未核实**「68%+ 测试覆盖率」**（**未运行 pytest**），**亦未核实**其 `.pre-commit-config.yaml` 与 `.readthedocs.yaml` 对应的构建是否可通**；**⑧ ⭐ **未核实**其 `docs/` 与 `examples/` 的内容量**（**根目录实测存在该两目录**）；**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ **该库面向**受监管的费率制定与申报工作****——**其输出若用于真实定价或申报须经持牌精算师复核并符合当地监管**；**`LICENSING.md` 自身即如此要求**（见标注 ① 与正文 ①）；**本词条**不主张**其可用于任何真实的费率申报、定价决策或监管提交**；**⑩ ⭐ **作者信息为公开可核实项**：**`LICENSING.md` 逐字署名「Author: Mehul Goyal」并给出邮箱与「Copyright: (c) 2026–present」**；**⑪ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、创建与推送同为 2026-09-07**，**关注度极低**，**不主张其成熟度、正确性或已被采用**（**尽管其功能面与文档量远超同类★0项目**）；**⑫ ⭐ 无 topics**；**⑬ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**（**README 与 `LICENSING.md` 实测均为英文**）。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/23BCE0066/InsureRisk-Insurance-Pricing-Risk-Analytics`、`/readme` 与 `/contents/` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取；README（20,121 字节）与 `LICENSING.md`（6,176 字节）经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字核对；`LICENSE` 于 main 分支实测 404；**未安装、未运行、未读源码**。
e.body_hk:
**InsureRisk** 是一個**面向非壽險的頻率-嚴重度 GLM 定價庫**（倉庫 `23BCE0066/InsureRisk-Insurance-Pricing-Risk-Analytics`），**實測 ★0、fork 0、主語言 Python、體量 259 KB、創建與最後推送均為 2026-09-07**（**在解凍窗口內**）；**⚠️ 許可情形特殊——GitHub API 報 `NONE` 且根目錄**沒有 `LICENSE` 文件（實測 404）**，**但倉庫內另有一份 **`LICENSING.md`（6,176 位元組）**逐字聲明為 **Mozilla Public License v2.0（MPL-2.0）**並詳列權利與義務****；**無 topics**；**README 實測 20,121 位元組**。本條目屬本輪主題**「說清楚什麼算它是對的」**中的**第一種：它把「誰該為輸出負責」寫得極為明確**。

可核實資訊（**均 README、`LICENSING.md` 與倉庫根目錄實測**）：**標題逐字「InsureRisk」，副標題逐字「Modern Actuarial Pricing Library for Non-Life Insurance」**，**定位句逐字「InsureRisk is a Python library for building **GLM-based frequency-severity pricing models** with a focus on **actuarial best practices**.」**。**根目錄實測**：**`.pre-commit-config.yaml`、`.readthedocs.yaml`、`INSTALLATION.md`（6,228）、**`LICENSING.md`（6,176）**、`README.md`（20,121）、`docs/`、`examples/`、`insurerisk/`、`pyproject.toml`、`tests/` 等**；**安裝逐字 `pip install insurerisk`**，**版本實測 **0.3.1****。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「Not Investment Advice」一節把**用戶責任**逐條寫出，是最值得引用的一處**——**逐字**：**「InsureRisk is a **computational tool**, not financial or actuarial advice. **Users are responsible for:** Validation of outputs in their specific context; Compliance with applicable insurance regulations; **Professional review of any models built with InsureRisk**; Appropriateness of assumptions and data.」**⭐⭐ **對準備把這類庫用進作業或實習的學生，這四條恰好是一條**從代碼到可辯護結論**的檢查清單**（可與 [[verified-reserving]]、[[reproducible-actuarial-work]]、[[fair-pricing-playbook]]、[[insurance-governance]] 並讀）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **監管申報能力是功能上最值得注意之處**——**「Regulatory Compliance」一節逐字含三項**：**`RateIndicationSummary`（實際賠付率、指示費率、可信度權重與**複核用選擇標記**）**；**`RateFilingPackage`（打包費率指示與錯位分析，**並對受保護類別屬性運行反歧視檢查**）**；**`SERFFExporter`（把費率相對數導出為 **SERFF 合規的 XML 或扁平 CSV 供監管提交（例如 AR、CA、GR 申報）**）**。⭐⭐⭐ **在美國，費率申報是**受監管的正式動作**，SERFF 是各州使用的申報系統——**一個開源庫做到導出 SERFF 格式並內置反歧視檢查，說明其目標用戶是**真的要做申報的定價人員****（**⚠️ 不主張**其導出確實符合 SERFF 技術規範或任何州的要求**；**⚠️ 「反歧視檢查」的判定規則本次未讀**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **七種 GLM 變體把同一框架擴到不同統計需求上**——**`GAM`**（平滑非線性效應）；**`MonotoneGLM`**（**對有序類別預測變數施加擬合後單調性約束**）；**`QuantileGLM`**（條件分位數回歸＋嚴重度扇形圖）；**`BayesianGLM`**（PyMC 貝葉斯泊松／伽馬 GLM，可信區間，可選依賴）；**`HierarchicalGLM`**（混合效應／分層 GLM，基於 `MixedLM`）**。⭐ **其中 `MonotoneGLM` 值得單獨記**：**費率表中**某因子應當單調**常是業務或監管要求**，**而普通 GLM 擬合出的係數未必單調****（**⚠️ 未讀源碼，不主張其方法與效果**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **一處**命名衝突的自我披露**在本會話很少見**——**逐字**：**「Note: `insurerisk.glm.qpp.FrequencyModel` is a **lightweight QPP-specific wrapper** and is **distinct from** the top-level `insurerisk.FrequencyModel` frequency-severity workflow class.」**⭐⭐ **InsureRisk** is **a frequency-severity GLM pricing library for non-life insurance** (repository `23BCE0066/InsureRisk-Insurance-Pricing-Risk-Analytics`), with **measured ★0, 0 forks, Python as the primary language, a 259 KB repository, created and last pushed 2026-09-07** (**all GitHub API measurements, inside the thaw window**); **⚠️ its licence situation is unusual — the GitHub API reports `NONE` and there is no `LICENSE` file at the root (404 on main), yet the repository carries a `LICENSING.md` (6,176 bytes) stating verbatim that it is licensed under the Mozilla Public License v2.0 (MPL-2.0) with rights and obligations spelled out** (**see note ① below**); it has **no topics**; **the README measures 20,121 bytes**. It is the first of this round’s four takes on **stating what would count as evidence that it is right**: **it is unusually explicit about who is responsible for the output**.

Verifiable details (**all measured from the README, `LICENSING.md` and the repository root**): **the title reads verbatim "InsureRisk" with the subtitle "Modern Actuarial Pricing Library for Non-Life Insurance"**, **and the positioning sentence reads verbatim "InsureRisk is a Python library for building GLM-based frequency-severity pricing models with a focus on actuarial best practices."** **The root measurably contains** **`.github`, `.gitignore`, `.pre-commit-config.yaml`, `.readthedocs.yaml`, `.tmp_changelog.txt`, `INSTALLATION.md` (6,228 bytes), `LICENSING.md` (6,176 bytes), `README.md` (20,121 bytes), `docs/`, `examples/`, `fix_docstrings.py`, `insurerisk/`, `package-lock.json`, `package.json`, `pyproject.toml` and `tests/`**; **installation reads verbatim `pip install insurerisk`**, **and the current version measurably is 0.3.1**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ A "Not Investment Advice" section spelling out the user’s responsibilities item by item is the entry’s most quotable passage** — **`LICENSING.md` reads verbatim**: **"InsureRisk is a computational tool, not financial or actuarial advice. Users are responsible for: Validation of outputs in their specific context; Compliance with applicable insurance regulations; Professional review of any models built with InsureRisk; Appropriateness of assumptions and data."** ⭐⭐ **For a student about to use such a library in coursework or an internship, those four items are precisely a checklist from code to a defensible conclusion** (**readable with [[verified-reserving]], [[reproducible-actuarial-work]], [[fair-pricing-playbook]] and [[insurance-governance]]**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ Regulatory filing capability is the entry’s most notable functional feature** — **a dedicated "Regulatory Compliance" section reads verbatim as three items**: **`insurerisk.compliance.RateIndicationSummary` reporting actual loss ratios, indicated rates, credibility weights and selection flags for rate review**; **`insurerisk.compliance.RateFilingPackage` bundling rate indications and dislocation analyses and running anti-discrimination checks on protected-class attributes**; **and `insurerisk.compliance.SERFFExporter` exporting rating relativities to SERFF-compliant XML or flat CSV for regulatory submission, with AR, CA and GR filings given as examples**. ⭐⭐⭐ **In the United States rate filing is a formal regulated act and SERFF is the system states use — an open-source library that exports SERFF format and builds in anti-discrimination checks is aimed at people who genuinely file rates** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim its export actually conforms to the SERFF technical specification or to any state’s requirements — nothing was run and no export was inspected; ⚠️ what the anti-discrimination check actually tests was also not read, and rate fairness has several coexisting and not fully consistent testing approaches**). **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Seven GLM variants extend one frequency-severity framework to different statistical needs, the entry’s most useful methodological grouping** — **`GAM`** (smooth non-linear effects); **`MonotoneGLM`** (**applying post-fit monotonicity constraints to ordered categorical predictors**); **`QuantileGLM`** (conditional quantile regression with severity fan plots); **`BayesianGLM`** (a PyMC-based Bayesian Poisson/Gamma GLM with credible intervals, behind an optional dependency); **`HierarchicalGLM`** (mixed-effects GLM on statsmodels `MixedLM`). ⭐ **`MonotoneGLM` deserves separate note**: **in a rating table, a factor being monotone (age increasing risk, say) is often a business or regulatory requirement, whereas an ordinary GLM fit need not produce monotone coefficients** (**⚠️ its implementation and effect were not read**). **④ ⭐⭐⭐ A self-disclosed naming collision is rare in this session** — verbatim: **"Note: `insurerisk.glm.qpp.FrequencyModel` is a lightweight QPP-specific wrapper and is distinct from the top-level `insurerisk.FrequencyModel` frequency-severity workflow class."** ⭐⭐ **For a library with a long maintenance life, naming a known trap in advance beats explaining it in an issue later** (**readable with round 330’s [[actuary-os]] and round 328’s [[creance]]**). **⑤ ⭐⭐ The Quantile Premium Principle is the entry’s most unusual pricing idea** — **described verbatim as pricing "from the policy-specific severity quantile implied by the frequency model’s zero-claim probability, rather than the expected loss"** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the principle is theoretically sound or adopted anywhere — its derivation was not read**). **⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ The remaining functional coverage is broad and consists of real steps in pricing practice** — distribution families including Poisson, negative binomial, gamma, inverse Gaussian, lognormal and **Tweedie**; link functions log, identity, inverse and inverse squared; ⭐ **"proper offset handling for exposure-based frequency models" listed separately**; diagnostics including AIC, BIC, deviance, dispersion and **overdispersion tests**; validation including **VIF** and correlation analysis; predictive performance including lift curves, the **Gini index** and residual plots; exposure calculation in days, months or years; rating tools including base rates and factor relativities, factor application, **trend adjustment**, **on-leveling**, **experience modification (EMR/XMod)** and **credibility weighting**; portfolio analysis including premium impact, **mix-shift decomposition**, winners-and-losers segments, rate adequacy, **price elasticity**, retention modelling and **constrained rate optimisation** (credibility bounds plus linear programming with dislocation analysis); and data tools including `DataQualityChecker` (missing-value and outlier reports, winsorising, factor consolidation, auto-binning, **leakage checks** and calibration curves). **⑦ ⭐⭐ Engineering quality is stated in checkable terms** — verbatim "Testing: 68%+ test coverage with pytest"; **the root measurably carries `.pre-commit-config.yaml` and `.readthedocs.yaml`**; **and a "Behavior note" reads verbatim**: **"`SeverityGLM.fit` performs zero filtering automatically and lognormal family is internally handled with transformation."** — **two inconspicuous behaviours that nonetheless change results, written into the release notes**. **⑧ ⭐ Readable with the site’s pricing and GLM entries**: [[insurance-pricing-tweedie]], [[tweedie-python]], [[easy-glm]], [[insurance-glm-tools]], [[insurance-distributional-glm]], [[shap-relativities]], [[ratemaking]], [[openrater]], [[ratecraft]], [[fair-pricing-playbook]], [[insurance-credibility]] and [[mg-credibility]].

**③ ⭐⭐⭐ Whether `SERFFExporter` actually conforms to the SERFF technical specification or any state’s filing requirements was not verified** — **only that the README describes it that way**; **this is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry**;
